tools.name: get_power_law_status
tools.description:
Where Bitcoin is against its power-law trend right now: live price, trend (fair) value, % deviation,
    zone, lower and upper band, the fit used and the next halving.

tools.name: get_trend_on_date
tools.description:
Power-law trend (fair) value and the lower/upper band on a date, past or future.
    `date` is YYYY-MM-DD (UTC), between 2010-07-18 and 2100-12-31.

tools.name: when_will_bitcoin_reach
tools.description:
When the power-law trend reaches a Bitcoin price, plus the earliest date (upper band, 3x trend: a
    historical ceiling that recent peaks stayed well below) and the date after which even the lower band (0.4x) stays above it.

tools.name: explain_power_law_model
tools.description: Background on the Bitcoin power-law model: the formula, how it is fitted, the bands, its limits, and the paper.
